description: This file defines the 'Map' data type class in Drupal, representing a complex associative array structure with methods for managing properties, values, and iteration.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A class representing a map data type, supporting property management, iteration, and data handling within Drupal's typed data system.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current values of the map properties, updating the internal values array.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets multiple property values at once, optionally notifying the parent object.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the map by concatenating property strings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property object by name, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific property value and triggers change notification.

methods.name: writePropertyValue
methods.description: Writes a property value directly without triggering change notifications.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns all properties, optionally including computed ones.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the map to an associative array of property values.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the map's properties.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the map has no non-computed, non-null properties.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the map, cloning properties.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change notifications, propagating to parent if needed.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Applies default values to all properties.
